title: AI signal draft
description: A signal draft awaiting review in data/signal-drafts/. Generated from scripts/lib/signal-schema.mjs and scripts/lib/review-schema.mjs by scripts/build-draft-schema.mjs — do not hand-edit.

$schema.description: Editor affordance. Stripped by signals:promote; never published.

summary.description: 3-7 sentences: what changed and why it matters for software work. Over ~120 words, split into paragraphs with \n\n — but never inside the first sentence, which the drawer lifts out as a lead. Plain prose: no **bold**.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Reserved placeholder domains (example.com, localhost, .test, .invalid) are rejected.

items.description: Open with a **bolded label of 2-5 words** carrying the claim, then an em dash, then one sentence. Two rendered lines, never more than three. Bold the label only.
Open with a **bolded label of 2-5 words** carrying the claim, then an em dash, then one sentence. Two rendered lines, never more than three. Bold the label only.
Open with a **bolded label of 2-5 words** carrying the claim, then an em dash, then one sentence. Two rendered lines, never more than three. Bold the label only.

_review.description: The REVIEWER writes this, never the finder. Rationale only — the folder you move the file into is the decision. Stripped by signals:promote and never published.

under.description: The rule that disqualified it. Hover a value for what it means.
enumDescriptions: Real signal, but not about this sector's subject.
Did not measure the thing the claim is about, however well reported.
States a principle or direction without the specifics the claim needs.
Data collected before the mechanism it is cited for existed.
Repeats figures it did not gather.
The same development is already live on the site.
The claim cannot be traced to a nameable source.
A recap of something else; the primary exists.
Content whose purpose is to sell the capability it describes.
Already evaluated in a previous run.
Search-optimised content whose numbers have no stated method.
The site already covers this from another angle.
Figures are modelled or illustrative rather than observed.
Found via an aggregator; the primary source was used.
Deferred by a per-run quota — NOT disqualified; a candidate for a later run.
The durable takeaway is a command, flag, config or library choice rather than a change in how work is organised.
Written by code when a decision was made without a rationale. Do not choose this by hand.

note.description: Why, specifically. Name the disqualifying fact: "the consequence is the exploit, not a policy change", not "not relevant".

reviewer.description: Defaults to git config user.name when omitted.
